name: Vegan Stuffed Acorn Squash with Wild Rice, Walnuts & Cranberries

instructions.primary_message: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup wild rice mix
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 30-35 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 acorn squash
1 lemon
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve each acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon, reserving a small handful for serving.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl along with cranberries, sugar, and spices; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup walnuts
½ cup dried cranberries
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the rice is done, fluff with a fork. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the stuffing.
Transfer squash halves to a serving platter, then fill with the rice stuffing; sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
